changeWalkthrough.thesis: Model routing becomes intent expressed to the orchestrator: four named tiers plus an unset default, one reach page per harness, a commented routing block the user edits in their own instruction file - and the role map, pin ceremony, staleness machinery and 179 shipped model-identifier mentions are deleted, with stage receipts recording what actually ran.
